tool_config.name: get_context
tool_config.description: Get the current workbench state: genre, loudness target, each bus's chain, meter readings, flagged symptoms, favorite count, custom plugin count. Call this before advising so you know what the producer is actually looking at.

tool_config.name: set_genre
tool_config.description: Switch the active genre (changes which plugins are starred as top picks).

tool_config.name: switch_tab
tool_config.description: Navigate the workbench to a different tab so Kev physically sees what you're working on with him.

tab.description: The tab id to switch to.

tool_config.name: set_platform
tool_config.description: Change the loudness target / platform (master bus reference).

tool_config.name: add_plugin_to_bus
tool_config.description: Add a plugin to a bus. The plugin name MUST match something in Kev's library. Position is 1-indexed; omit to append at end.

plugin.description: Plugin name â€” must be one Kev owns.

tool_config.name: remove_plugin_from_bus
tool_config.description: Remove a plugin from a bus by its 1-indexed position.

tool_config.name: move_plugin
tool_config.description: Reorder a plugin within a bus. Positions are 1-indexed.

tool_config.name: clear_bus
tool_config.description: Remove all plugins from a bus.

tool_config.name: toggle_symptom
tool_config.description: Toggle a flagged mix symptom in the Troubleshooter. Use the symptom id from list_symptoms.

tool_config.name: list_symptoms
tool_config.description: List available symptom ids and their labels.

tool_config.name: toggle_favorite
tool_config.description: Heart / un-heart a plugin in the library (fuzzy name match).

tool_config.name: record_meter
tool_config.description: Record a meter reading. meter is one of: iLufs, tp, lra, corr, crest.

tool_config.name: add_custom_plugin
tool_config.description: Add a plugin to the library that isn't already built in. stage must be one of the known stage ids.

publisher.description: slate, ssl, ua, softube, sonnox, sonible, sndtoys, izotope, eiosis, weiss, oek, waves, ni, pa, ant, cele, liq, or other

publisher_label.description: If publisher is other, supply a label like FabFilter

tool_config.name: remove_custom_plugin
tool_config.description: Remove a CUSTOM plugin from Kev's library. Built-in plugins cannot be removed â€” only ones added via add_custom_plugin. Match by name (fuzzy match supported).

name.description: Plugin name. Fuzzy match â€” but only custom plugins are eligible.

tool_config.name: list_plugins
tool_config.description: Search the plugin library. Pass stage_id or search text.

tool_config.name: get_library
tool_config.description: Return the full current plugin library grouped by stage. Call this if Kev mentions he just added plugins or you want a fresh dump.

tool_config.name: set_plugin_settings
tool_config.description: Pin concrete setting notes to a specific plugin on a bus. USE THIS EVERY TIME you give specific parameter values â€” the notes persist in the UI so Kev doesn't have to scroll the transcript.

plugin.description: Plugin name â€” fuzzy match. Use this OR position.

position.description: 1-indexed position on the bus. Use this OR plugin.

settings.description: Terse, actionable notes. Prefer one parameter per line. Max ~6 lines.

tool_config.name: clear_plugin_settings
tool_config.description: Remove settings notes from a plugin on a bus.

tool_config.name: inspect_app
tool_config.description: Search the live AI Mix Masters source code (index.html) for a term â€” function name, button id, CSS class, label text, anything. USE THIS when Kev asks what a button actually does or how something works under the hood.

tool_config.name: read_doc
tool_config.description: Read one of Kev's project docs â€” CLAUDE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, or DASHBOARD.html. USE THIS when Kev asks what's on the roadmap, what shipped recently, or what the handover says.

tool_config.name: read_yt_knowledge
tool_config.description: Fetch the full transcript of an ingested YouTube video from the YOUTUBE KNOWLEDGE BASE. Call this AFTER search_yt_knowledge has identified a relevant video_id, to pull more of that specific video's transcript. Optionally pass a query to get back only the most relevant chunks (recommended — keeps output lean). Returns up to ~4KB of transcript content. Brief Kev before calling: 'Let me take a look, checking my notes from that video…'. Cite the video title and channel when you draw from the result.

video_id.description: The video_id — from a prior search_yt_knowledge result, or the YOUTUBE TOPIC INDEX fast-path list, e.g. '6WPtHxWkY2k'.

query.description: Optional keyword or phrase to find the most relevant chunks. E.g. 'quantise', 'drum pattern', 'recording audio'. If omitted, returns the first few chunks.

tool_config.name: emit_notebooklm_prompt
tool_config.description: Drop a NotebookLM prompt for a producer or technique into the Conversation transcript as a separate copyable bubble â€” without reading the whole template aloud. USE THIS whenever you offer a NotebookLM prompt and Kev says yes.

topic.description: Short, specific topic from Kev's question â€” producer or technique name.

tool_config.name: capture_to_roadmap
tool_config.description: Capture a concrete idea, bug, polish item, or feature request to Kev's project dashboard inbox. CRITICAL: NEVER say 'I will add it to the roadmap' without calling this tool â€” that is confabulation.

force.description: Set true only after Kev confirms he wants to log a near-duplicate.

tool_config.name: list_eq_tiles
tool_config.description: List the cards on the Reference tab, optionally filtered by section.

tool_config.name: add_eq_tile
tool_config.description: Add a custom reference tile to the Reference tab. Lead with your audio mastering knowledge â€” suggest the right section and propose a concrete title and body grounded in real ranges.

tool_config.name: remove_eq_tile
tool_config.description: Remove a custom Reference tile by title or id. Built-in tiles cannot be deleted.

tool_config.name: list_knowledge_notes
tool_config.description: List Knowledge Base notes â€” id, title, source, tags, ts, active flag.

active_only.description: If true, only notes currently injected into session context are returned.

tool_config.name: add_knowledge_note
tool_config.description: Add a research/technique note to Kev's Knowledge Base. Keep titles concise and content focused.

content.description: The note body. Plain text, can be multi-line.

activate.description: If true, the note becomes part of the voice session context immediately.

tool_config.name: export_knowledge_note
tool_config.description: Export a Knowledge Base note to disk or clipboard.

target.description: download = save a .md file. clipboard = copy text to system clipboard.

tool_config.name: save_preset
tool_config.description: Save the current chain as a named user preset. CRITICAL: if Kev has NOT said what to call the preset, ask him first â€” never invent a name. Only call this tool once you have an actual name from him.

name.description: The exact name Kev told you to use.

bus.description: Which bus to save. Default 'all' saves every non-empty bus.

tool_config.name: open_dashboard
tool_config.description: Opens the live AIMM project dashboard in a new browser tab. Use this when Kev wants to review the roadmap, check what's in flight, or scan the backlog together. Offer it naturally: 'Want me to pull up the dashboard so we can look at it together?' â€” then call it if he says yes.

tool_config.name: search_yt_knowledge
tool_config.description: Search the FULL YouTube Knowledge Base (all ingested videos, hundreds and growing) for chunks relevant to a topic. This is the PRIMARY way to discover KB content — call it on ANY mixing, production, or plugin question before answering from general knowledge. Returns the top-scoring transcript chunks with their video_id/title/channel so you can cite properly. Once you have a promising video_id, call read_yt_knowledge(video_id, query) for more of that specific video. Brief Kev before calling: 'Let me take a look, checking my notes…'. Cite the video title and channel when you draw from the result.

query.description: The topic or question to search for, e.g. 'sidechain kick and bass', 'Logic Pro file organization', 'de-essing harsh vocals'.

n.description: Optional number of chunks to return (default 6, max 10).

tool_config.name: set_stem_selection
tool_config.description: Control AIMM Mix Check loaded stem audition and playback when Kev asks. Set, add, remove or clear exact loaded stem names; play, pause, stop, seek, skip, set monitor volume, or read status. For play, optional tracks selects the group before playback. Return the confirmed selected tracks and transport state. Do not claim success if the client returns an error.

tracks.description: Exact loaded stem names or filenames. Required for set, add and remove; optional for play.

items.description: One exact loaded stem name or filename.

position_seconds.description: Absolute time in seconds for seek.

offset_seconds.description: Relative seconds for skip; negative rewinds.

tool_config.name: manage_roadmap_inbox
tool_config.description: Manage AIMM dashboard Captured from voice inbox. First list entries to get IDs. Remove only when Kev explicitly asks to delete; promote marks done/actioned; edit changes title/body. Adding is handled by capture_to_roadmap. Return confirmed result.

id.description: Entry ID from list, preferred target.

title_match.description: Fallback title substring when ID is unknown.

tool_config.name: propose_mix_move
tool_config.description: Show Kev a structured Mix Move card with an Apply button for one specific processing recommendation. Verify the plugin is in his library first. Use when recommending a concrete EQ, compression or plugin move; let Kev decide whether to apply. Return confirmed card result.

move.description: Brief processing move with starting settings.

why.description: Why this move addresses the heard or measured issue.

settings.description: Optional settings note shown under the plugin when applied.

tool_config.name: mark_fix_applied
tool_config.description: Mark the CURRENT Mix Check fix as applied and advance the Fix Queue to the next item. Call ONLY after Kev confirms he handled the fix you were discussing (you asked 'want me to mark that done and bring in #02?' and he said yes). Never pre-emptively, never to skip a fix he has not acted on. After calling, confirm in one short line and name the next fix.

fix_id.description: Optional fix id such as '#01'. Omit to mark the current active fix â€” the normal case.

tool_config.name: list_symptom_tiles
tool_config.description: List all troubleshooting tiles currently shown on the Repair tab — built-in and custom. Use this to find a tile id before deleting, or to check what already exists before adding a similar tile.

tool_config.name: add_symptom_tile
tool_config.description: Add a custom troubleshooting tile to AIMM’s Repair tab. Provide label, diagnosis, chain as a JSON string containing an array of steps (each step has n exact plugin name, p publisher key, set concrete settings), and optional alt. Every plugin must be confirmed in Kev’s library.

chain.description: JSON array string of plugin steps, each object has n, p, set.

tool_config.name: delete_symptom_tile
tool_config.description: Delete a custom troubleshooting tile by its custom-* id. Call list_symptom_tiles first when the id is unknown. The AIMM app will ask Kev to confirm; if he declines, the tile remains.

tool_config.name: web_search_fallback
tool_config.description: Last resort. Call this ONLY after search_yt_knowledge and read_yt_knowledge have returned nothing usable for the question. Never call it first. Use it for live facts such as plugin manuals, release dates or chart data that the knowledge base does not hold.

query.description: The specific question to search the web for.

tool_config.name: pluginhub_navigate
tool_config.description: Navigate the live Plugin Hub sidebar. This opens the Plugins tab if needed, then selects the requested status, Library filter, category, or tool. Returns a snapshot of the whole sidebar plus the selected live view. This changes only the visible view; it does not scan, download, share, or add anything. Use it whenever Kev asks to open or inspect one of the Plugin Hub menu items. Disabled items return their current unavailable reason; connected items can open their existing screen.

item.description: The exact Plugin Hub sidebar item to open.

tool_config.name: pluginhub_search_inventory
tool_config.description: Search the current local Plugin Hub scan, not the separate MixBus catalogue. Returns plug-ins recorded by this browser; synthetic preview rows are explicitly marked and are not proof of installed plug-ins. Search never scans folders or changes MixBus. Use live scan results to verify an installed plug-in before discussing it or adding it to a MixBus.

query.description: Words from the plug-in or publisher name; an empty query lists the current scanned inventory.

limit.description: Number of product results to return, maximum 50.

tool_config.name: pluginhub_add_to_bus
tool_config.description: Add an exact plug-in from the current local Plugin Hub scan to a MixBus. Requires its exact installed name and publisher, one of the five buses, and a valid MixBus stage id. Call only when Kev explicitly asks to put that plug-in on a bus. The scan is checked first; no unscanned or invented product can be added through this tool.

plugin.description: Exact plug-in name returned by pluginhub_search_inventory.

stage.description: MixBus stage id from get_library (for example eq-clean, bus-comp, reverb). Use a confident functional match; if uncertain, ask Kev before adding.

position.description: Optional 1-based position on the bus; omit to append.
